question: Which Ministry is responsible for collecting data and publishing literacy rates in India?

options.text: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation

solution:
The correct answer is the__** Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI) **is responsible for collecting data and publishing literacy rates in India: 
 
• **Literacy rates**
 
 
• The MoSPI publishes literacy rates for India and states, i**ncluding gender-wise literacy rates for rural and urban areas. **
 
• **Census of India**
 
• The **MoSPI's National Statistical Office provides information on literacy rates, such as the 2017 literacy rate of 77.7%. **
 
• The MoSPI also monitors the performance of the country's infrastructure sectors, central sector projects, and the Members of Parliament Local Area Development Scheme (MPLADS). 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI):**

 
 
• This **ministry was formed in 1999 by merging the Department of Statistics and the Department of Programme Implementation.**
 
• It has two wings: **Statistics and Programme Implementation.**
 
• The Statistics Wing includes the National Statistical Office (NSO),
 
 
• which is made up of the Central Statistics Office (CSO) and the National Sample Survey Office (NSSO).
 
• The Programme Implementation (PI) Wing has three divisions:
 
 
• Central Twenty Point Programme (TPP), Infrastructure and Project Monitoring (IPM), and Members of Parliament Local Area Development Scheme (MPLADS). 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Rural Development: **The current Minister of Rural Development is Shri Shivraj Singh Chauhan. 
 
• **Ministry of External Affairs**: The current Minister of External Affairs is Subrahmanyam Jaishankar. 
 
• **Ministry of Educat**ion: The current Minister of State for Education is Dr. Sukanta Majumdar.
